# V1 routing decision corpus

The corpus contains pure inputs and exact expected outcomes for repository-scope, required-label and explicit target selection. It uses stable contract label references while observed inputs carry exact provider label names.

Issue-store comparison is ASCII case-insensitive for owner login and repository name. Label-name comparison is exact and case-sensitive. Trace arrays use exact label-reference order. General, sub-project and undeclared labels do not participate in overall-Project routing.

The richer classification corpus is in testdata/labels/v1/cases.json.
